title: AuditEvent
description: Audit event emitted by TerraForge modules for government traceability

eventId.description: Unique identifier for this audit event

timestamp.description: RFC3339 timestamp of when the event occurred

actor.description: The actor (user or system) that triggered this event

action.description: The action performed (e.g., calculate_cost, valuate, generate_packet)

resourceId.description: The resource identifier (e.g., parcelId) this event relates to

module.description: The TerraForge module that emitted this event
